definitions.explanation: A dramatic reversal of fortune, especially a comeback victory in sports, an unexpected turnaround in business, or a surprising change of outcome. The word {劇|げき} (drama) emphasizes the dramatic or theatrical nature of the reversal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}だった。
⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A dramatic comeback occurred in the second half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧で、⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: In a match everyone thought they would lose, a historic comeback was born.

notes:
{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき} is a compound of ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ (reversal) + ⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧ (drama). The ⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧ emphasizes the theatrical, exciting nature of the turnaround.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to stage a dramatic comeback
- {逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a turnaround occurs
- ⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧な{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}: a dramatic comeback
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}: a historic comeback
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{逆転劇|ぎゃくてんげき}: a splendid comeback

DOMAINS:
Most frequent in sports journalism (comeback victories), but also used for business turnarounds, political reversals, and election upsets.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧: reversal (without the dramatic nuance)
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}{勝|が}ち→逆転勝ち：08584_gyakutengachi⟧: come-from-behind victory
- ⟦{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}→大逆転：21652_daigyakuten⟧: a great reversal
